emma_support: URGENT — acme-corp (acct: acme-42) hitting failures in prod when making tool/function calls. They started after last rollout. Returning 400 with error `tool_schema_mismatch`. Ticket INC-5234. Logs below, reproduction attached.

mohit_runtime: on it — can you paste the raw request body and the model name/version? also which rollout revision?

emma_support: pasted sample (keys redacted):
```json
{
  \"model\": \"gpt-open-3.2\",\n  \"input\": \"Summarize transactions\",\n  \"tool_call\": {\n    \"name\": \"bank_txn_lookup\",\n    \"args\": \"[\\\"acct_id\\\", 12345]\"  // suspicious: args is a JSON-encoded string\n  },\n  \"request_id\": \"req-9a7b\"\n}
```

emma_support: and server-side error snippet: 
```
ERROR 2026-03-17T14:02:11Z request=req-9a7b validation failed: tool 'bank_txn_lookup' arg schema mismatch: expected object, got string (code: tool_schema_mismatch)
    at validateToolArgs (/srv/runtime/validators.js:213)
    at handleToolCall (/srv/runtime/calls.js:88)
```

ops-bot: deployed revision r-20260317-42 to prod (canary 5% -> now 100%) :rocket:

julian_sre: looks like the args field is a string containing JSON instead of an array/object. That would cause AJV to reject it. Did the client change how they pass `args`? Or did our wrapper start double-encoding? :eyes:

ryan_se: customer says it was fine before the rollout on 2026-03-10, they didn't change client. I ran a local repro: run this curl to see same error:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://inference.redwood.ai/v1/call \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{\"model\":\"gpt-open-3.2\",\"tool_call\":{\"name\":\"bank_txn_lookup\",\"args\":\"[\\\"acct_id\\\", 12345]\"}}'
```

ryan_se: backend treats `args` as already-parsed JSON and tries to validate against schema { type: \"array\" }, so string -> validation error. Repro is instant.

mohit_runtime: I checked recent runtime patch — our agent wrapper (agent-proxy v1.9.0 -> v1.10.0) introduced a change that JSON-encodes tool args for transport to the runner to preserve types across older kernels. Seems we forgot to decode on the other side. Rolling patch to validate both string-encoded JSON and raw objects. Will push hotfix.

mohit_runtime: PR #6523 opened: runtime: accept JSON-encoded tool args and auto-deserialize before schema validation. Also added defensive logging and metrics for `tool_schema_mismatch`. Tests included.

julian_sre: mitigation steps for support:
- rollback agent-proxy to v1.9.0 on affected pools (if hotfix ETA > 30m)
- or set routing policy for acme-corp to fallback model variant that avoids function-calling until patched
- as a short-term server-side mitigation, we can attempt best-effort JSON.parse when `typeof args === 'string'` and increment a metric so we can find affected customers

emma_support: customer prefers non-breaking mitigation. I applied routing fallback to `gpt-open-3.2-no-tools` for acme-42 and confirmed requests succeed (they get non-tool responses). Customer OK with that while we hotfix.

mohit_runtime: deploying hotfix to prod now. Will post deploy id and ETA.

ops-bot: deploying revision r-20260317-43 (hotfix) to prod canary 10% -> 100%

mohit_runtime: hotfix live on prod. Verified with the curl repro; now returns 200 and tool output. Added a migration flag to log occurrences of string-encoded args for 72h.

sanjay_customer_rep: updated INC-5234: workaround applied, hotfix deployed, customer validated end-to-end. They want postmortem + root cause.

emma_support: thanks team. Labeling as escalated -> postmortem required. Notes for postmortem: root cause = agent-proxy change double-encoding args, missed decoding path in runner; impact = multiple customers hitting tool_schema_mismatch 400s; mitigation = routing fallback + hotfix; follow-ups = add schema-tolerant parsing, add CI case covering both encoded and raw args, add canary tests that exercise tool calling paths.

ryan_se: adding repro snippet and logs to the ticket and linking PR.

julian_sre: will monitor metrics for `tool_schema_mismatch` over next 48h and surface any residuals.

emma_support: closing thread here, will attach postmortem draft to INC-5234 once ready. :white_check_mark:
